editorial: You walk into a normal coastal Australian supermarket, then a freak tsunami turns an ordinary shopping trip into a fight for survival. Shoppers get trapped inside the flooded building with a massive great white shark, and every aisle becomes a danger zone. The mix of panic, rising water, tight spaces, and desperate people keeps you on edge while the characters try to stay alive and help each other. The action moves fast, the shark attacks are tense, and the cast sells the fear well enough to keep you invested. Some effects look rough and a few character choices feel silly, but the movie still delivers wild, messy thrills. It is not high art, but it is a fun late-night watch. If you enjoy creature features and disaster chaos, give it a shot. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the survivors use the flooded store and parking area to fight back against the shark. They lure it, trap it, and finally kill it after several close calls. Some characters do not survive, but the main group escapes. The water threat eases, and the remaining shoppers make it out alive. The movie ends with relief and the sense that the nightmare is finally over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves shark movies and disaster thrillers.
